page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with no marginal notes. Running head at top; page number at top right; signature at foot left.

p.i: cui jurgia? cui solicitudo? cui vulnera impune? cui oculorum rubor? Vini sectatoribus, compotationes rimatum euntibus. G. Nolite vino inebriari, sed cum bonis viris H. & se probè gerentibus, G. consuetudinem habete ac versamini. Vinum ne aspice quia rubeat, quia in poculo colorem suum ostentet, & specie sua blandiatur. Ejus exitus mordet ut coluber, & vipera modo pungit. Et oculi tui absurdè videbunt, & animus ineptè loquetur. Erisque quasi qui in medio mari, aut quasi qui in mali navis vertice cubet. Verberatus non doleo, i[?]ctus non sentio, experrectus idem iterum requiram.
Stillicidium pluvio tempore perflu-ens, & uxor rixosa similia sunt. Eam qui recondit, ventum recondit, aut cla-maturum in dextera sua unguentum.

page.notes: The running head reads NUPTIALES. The page number is printed with an old-style 3, read as 503. The word after "specie" has a squiggle at the line end that I could not resolve, so I left "specie" with "sua" following. The first letter of "ictus" is worn and read as I with [?]. Numbers LXXXIIII and LXXXV are bare numbers, so they are paragraphs. The signature "Ii 4" is at the foot.
